text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Asahi Hai FS.
While waiting in the ready room—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hey, is there still time?
We're completely out of spare tape.
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, you always wear that on your nose.
Come to think of it, you always wear that on your nose.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
It just feels more comfortable to have it on.
Though I've forgotten when I first started wearing it...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Well, fine. Mind if I go buy some tape?
A convenience store should have just about anything."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even so, Narita Brian has already changed clothes. If she goes outside, she'll stand out quite a bit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Besides, more than anything, it would be a shame
to waste her time right before the race.
choice_data_list: I'll go buy it for you instead.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Then I'm counting on you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I don't care about quality. The cheapest one is fine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just to be sure, I checked the brand she usually uses and headed to a shop near the racetrack, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Products from various manufacturers lined the shelves.
From long-established brands to new items claiming to improve focus."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Some even have scented relaxation effects or elastic stretchiness—"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...And so? You bought out every single tape on the shelf, is that it?
choice_data_list: ...I paid for it myself, so don't worry about it.
...I paid for it out of my own pocket, so please don't worry about it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: That's not what I'm talking about. Good grief.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Basically, Trainer contracts last three years from debut.
If you can't produce solid results, there's always the chance the contract will be terminated.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"And yet you bought a mountain of tape.
What will you do if I keep losing and my contract is terminated?"
choice_data_list: If it's Brian, she won't lose

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
choice_data_list: If it's Brian, she can beat any opponent!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Haha... You're far too blindly devoted. Idiot.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Good grief. And?
Which tape lets you concentrate the best?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'll use that one first.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...It's not a bad feel.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. In a race, the one who crosses the finish line
first is the winner, right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Don't make me repeat myself.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Whatever. I'll crush whoever stands in my way.
Victory belongs to ME...!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Quite a crowd has gathered.
I guess that's the Asahi Hai FS for you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Brian... If you put on a boring race,
I'm gonna laugh right in your face...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, watched over by a massive crowd of people,
the Asahi Hai FS was about to begin.
